flash_blind_test.name: Flash blind test
flash_blind_test.pitch: Recognise the clip as fast as you can!
rules: The clip plays for 1 second, then 5, then 20.
The first to buzz answers alone with A, B, C or D.
The sooner you find it, the more you score: 100, 50 or 20 points.
A mistake costs nothing, but you cannot buzz again until the next stage.

quick_answer.name: Quick answer
quick_answer.pitch: Everyone answers, the fastest scores most!
rules: Everyone answers at the same time with A, B, C or D.
Only your first answer counts.
A right answer is worth 100 points (right away) down to 20 points (at the end).
A mistake costs nothing.

first_buzz.name: First buzz
rules: Read the question, then buzz with any button.
The first to buzz answers alone with A, B, C or D.
Right answer: 100 points.
Wrong answer: 25 points penalty and the hand passes.

true_false.name: Flash true or false
true_false.pitch: A burst of statements: make the call!
rules: A = True, B = False.
Everyone answers at the same time, in a few seconds.
Each right answer is worth 50 points.

double_or_nothing.name: Double or nothing
double_or_nothing.pitch: Bet before you see the question!
rules: Before the question, bet with your buzzers: A = pass, B = 100, C = 200, D = all in.
All in puts your whole score at stake (at least 300 points).
Right answer: you win your stake. Wrong answer or silence: you lose it.
Without a bet, you play for 100 points.

sudden_death.name: Sudden death
sudden_death.pitch: One mistake and you are out!
rules: Everyone answers at the same time: 50 points per right answer.
A mistake or no answer: out until the end of the round.
If every survivor is wrong, nobody is out.
The last one standing grabs a 200 points bonus.

point_steal.name: Point steal
point_steal.pitch: The fastest steals from an opponent!
rules: Everyone answers at the same time: 50 points per right answer.
The fastest right player picks an opponent with their buzzers (A = desk 1, B = desk 2…).
With 5 or 6 desks: A moves the target back, B moves it forward, C or D confirms it.
They steal up to 100 points.
Without a choice, the steal targets the player with the most points.

streak.name: Streak
streak.pitch: Chain right answers to raise your multiplier!
rules: Everyone answers at the same time with A, B, C or D.
A right answer is worth 25 points × your multiplier.
Each right answer in a row raises the multiplier, up to ×5.
A mistake or silence drops it back to ×1.

estimate.name: Estimate
rules: Ranges go from the smallest (A) to the largest.
Everyone answers at the same time.
Right range: 100 points. Neighbouring range: 30 points.

progressive_reveal.name: Progressive reveal
progressive_reveal.pitch: The picture shows up bit by bit: find it first!
rules: The blurred picture sharpens for 20 seconds.
The first to buzz freezes it and answers alone with A, B, C or D.
The sooner you find it, the more you score: 100 down to 20 points.
A mistake costs nothing, but you can no longer buzz on this picture.
